elements.name: tj-startup-loader
elements.description: Coordinates startup-aware elements and reveals content after initialization.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Uses the global page queue by default or limits coordination to this element's subtree.

attributes.name: debug
attributes.description: Enables detailed startup registration and lifecycle logging.

attributes.name: observe-scroll-element
attributes.description: CSS selector for the element whose scroll position is restored after startup.

slots.name: loader
slots.description: Optional theme-provided loader shown while startup is in progress.

classes.name: stay-open
classes.description: Keeps the loader slot visible for debugging.
